references.text: The preceding verse shows that the healed man was asked who had healed him, which explains why it is emphasized in verse 13 that he did not know who Jesus was. See [ref:Joh 5:12|John 5:12].
Jesus later finds the man in the temple and reveals himself to him, contrasting with the fact that the man in verse 13 did not know who Jesus was. See [ref:Joh 5:14|John 5:14].
Here too Jesus withdraws and hides from the crowd, similarly to how he escaped the crowd after the healing. See [ref:Joh 12:36|John 12:36].
Jesus hid and left the temple when the crowd wanted to stone him, just as he here slipped away from the crowd after the healing at the Pool of Bethesda. See [ref:Joh 8:59|John 8:59].
Also after the bread miracle, Jesus withdrew from the crowd that wanted to make him king, showing a pattern where Jesus deliberately avoids the attention of the masses. See [ref:Joh 6:15|John 6:15].
Jesus walked straight through the crowd and left when they tried to seize him, similar to his withdrawal from the crowd at Bethesda. See [ref:Luk 4:30|Luke 4:30].
